product_metadata.title: Kurt Adler Petite Treasures 12-Piece Miniature Ornaments Set, (4 Pack) for Christmas
description: These Petite Treasures mini ornaments from Kurt Adler are a charming addition to your holiday décor! This set features two assorted boxes. One box features Santas, snowmen, wreath, snowflakes, Christmas tree, candy cane, and penguin ornaments. The other box features snowflake, snowmen, gingerbread man, Santas, angel, Christmas tree, teddy bear, and bird ornaments.
